import datetime, json, os, pathlib, subprocess, sys, time
scratch = pathlib.Path('/private/tmp/sf-qtlarger')
label, *args = sys.argv[1:]
run = scratch / label
run.mkdir()
(run / 'tmp').mkdir()
env = dict(os.environ, QT_RUN_RECORD=str(run/'phases.jsonl'), TMPDIR=str(run / 'tmp')+'/', HYPOTHESIS_STORAGE_DIRECTORY=str(scratch/'hyp'),
           UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=str(scratch/'venv'), UV_CACHE_DIR=str(scratch/'uv-cache'),
           PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1', SUBFLEET_SWIFT_NESTED_SANDBOX='off',
           CLANG_MODULE_CACHE_PATH=str(scratch/'clang-cache'), SWIFT_MODULECACHE_PATH=str(scratch/'swift-cache'))
command = ['/bin/zsh','/Users/maxghenis/reviews/subfleet-hub/host-runs/suite_hold.sh','env','-u','SUBFLEET_RETENTION_DORMANT','-u','PYTHONPATH',
           'uv','run','--no-sync','pytest','-q','-s','-p','no:cacheprovider','-p','qt_record','--basetemp',str(run/'pytest'),
           '--junitxml',str(run/'junit.xml'),*args]
outside = label.endswith('-direct')
if outside: command = command[2:]
start = time.time()
meta = {'label':label, 'runner_pid':os.getpid(), 'runner_pgid':os.getpgrp(), 'outside_lock':outside, 'queued':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'load':os.getloadavg(), 'args':args}
(run/'run.json').write_text(json.dumps(meta))
print(json.dumps(meta),flush=True)
with (run/'output.txt').open('w') as out:
 result = subprocess.run(command,env=env,stdout=out,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
meta.update(returncode=result.returncode, elapsed=time.time()-start, finished=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(), end_load=os.getloadavg())
(run/'run.json').write_text(json.dumps(meta))
print(json.dumps(meta),flush=True)
print((run/'output.txt').read_text()[-3500:],flush=True)
sys.exit(result.returncode)
prebuild_driver:
import datetime,hashlib,json,os,pathlib,resource,sys,time
sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
root=pathlib.Path('/private/tmp/sf-qtlarger')
label,*names=sys.argv[1:]
folder=root/label; folder.mkdir(); (folder/'tmp').mkdir()
os.environ.update(TMPDIR=str(folder/'tmp')+'/',PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1',SUBFLEET_SWIFT_NESTED_SANDBOX='off',CLANG_MODULE_CACHE_PATH=str(root/'clang-cache'),SWIFT_MODULECACHE_PATH=str(root/'swift-cache'))
meta=dict(label=label,build_only=True,runner_pid=os.getpid(),runner_pgid=os.getpgrp(),queued=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),load=os.getloadavg(),args=names,builds=[])
(folder/'output.txt').write_text('')
def save(): (folder/'run.json').write_text(json.dumps(meta))
save()
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()))
from tests.frontend import test_review_r219_fix8_mutations as mutations
original=mutations.compile_probe
def build(*a,**kw):
 kw['timeout']=1800
 return original(*a,**kw)
mutations.compile_probe=build
status=0
for name in names:
 dest=folder/name; dest.mkdir()
 start=time.time()
 entry=dict(mutation=name,started=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),load=os.getloadavg())
 meta['builds'].append(entry);save()
 print(json.dumps(entry),flush=True)
 try:
  binary,_=mutations.compile_mutation(name,dest)
  entry.update(outcome='built',binary_sha256=hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),bytes=binary.stat().st_size)
 except Exception as exc:
  entry.update(outcome='build_error',error=str(exc)[-3000:]);status=1
 entry.update(elapsed=time.time()-start,finished=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),maxrss_child=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss)
 with (folder/'output.txt').open('a') as out:out.write(json.dumps(entry)+'\n')
 save(); print(json.dumps(entry),flush=True)
meta.update(returncode=status,finished=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat());save()
sys.exit(status)
